Bench: Manoj Kumar Tiwari, Pankaj Purohit
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
 or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  13.06.2024 CRLA No. 311 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Akshay Pradhan, learned counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. J. S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General assisted by Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. This is an appeal filed by the appellant against the judgment and order dated 17.08.2023 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO), District Pithoragarh in Special Sessions Trial No. 13 of 2020,
whereby the appellant has been convicted of the charge of offence punishable under Sections 363,
366-A, 376(2)(i)(n)(3) of IPC and sentenced to undergo twenty years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 50,000/- under Section 376(2)(i)(n)(3) of IPC with default stipulation

, he has been further convicted and sentenced to undergo seven years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 10,000/- under Section 363 of IPC with default stipulation and he has also been convicted and sentenced to undergo ten years rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 20,000/- under Section 366-A of IPC with default stipulation.
4.
As per the office report, there is delay of 203 days in filing the appeal.
Meanwhile, learned State counsel may file objections to Delay Condonation Application.

Akash CRLA/311/2024 on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199656372/
1
